files.description: Playwright tests for Albums covering the overview and sidebar, create/delete and duplicate-name validation, selected and filter-wide photo adds, URL-backed selection across pagination, edit-mode cover and member removal, persistent drag reorder, and the no-paired-devices Share modal state.

testContext: The standard isolated runner seeds Seeded Album with four photos and a 16-item library (14 photos plus two videos). Album tests mutate shared state and run in one worker via test.describe.configure({ mode: 'default' }). /albums renders .album-tile entries and .albums-sidebar links; /albums/<id> renders #album-grid cards keyed by data-select-id; /albums/<id>/add renders #add-grid, #add-selection, and #add-to-album-button. Selection is URL-backed with repeated select_id values or select=all plus exclude_id, and the add button's data-match-count represents the full filtered scope rather than the visible page. Add success remains on /add with added=N. Edit mode is ?edit=1; cover and removal use #set-cover-button and #remove-from-album-button. Delete/removal use #global-confirm-dialog, not a native dialog. Reorder uses HTML5 drag events and POSTs repeated media_item_id fields to /reorder. The standard environment has no paired devices; #shareAlbumModal contains no device checkboxes and displays the pair-first empty state.
explanation: Completed manually from specs/albums.yaml after inspecting the album templates, routes, client code, shared selection component, repository Playwright conventions, and live behavior in a freshly seeded isolated environment. The nine scenarios clean up album creation, names, membership, and order; the selected cover is retained because no test depends on the original. Validated with npx tsc --noEmit and BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5002 npx playwright test generated_tests/albums/albums.spec.ts --project=chromium (9 passed on 2026-07-18).
